title: JSON for Networking: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A shipping manifest lists everything in a neat, standard way. Machines can read it without guessing. That's what J S O N does for data.

scenes.heading: The manifest
scenes.narration: J S O N has a few strict rules. Keys and text must use double quotes. It has six types, including objects and arrays. No trailing commas are allowed. And no comments are allowed either.

items.real: String, number, boolean, null, object, array

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Only double quotes work. J S O N has no comments. The pipe doesn't work on every command.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Double quotes, no trailing commas, no comments. Six data types. It's how scripts read device data. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva JSON lab.

points.t: Double quotes; no trailing commas; no comments
